description: Calls a listing of the agents market by its id (svc_..., from agents_market_search), paid from this key's USDF balance (never free credit) within the key's and its agent's limits and at most max_price: what one call costs and nothing on top; a call its seller does not answer 2xx costs nothing, or no more than what its seller kept of it. Every listing is called the same way, and answers 503 market_calls_unarmed while calls to the market are not switched on. Needs an API key. Returns the seller's answer and the receipt. The input goes to the seller, whose own policy governs what it keeps.

input.description: What the call sends: JSON for a POST listing, an object of plain values (its query) for a GET one

max_price.description: The most this call may cost in USDF ("0.05"): required, as a seller may change its price; the listing's price is in agents_market_search

name: agents_market_call
title: Call a listing
